source: A notation such as W4A16 usually means the weights are stored in a 4-bit representation while activations remain around ZXNAME0000XZ/ZXNAME0001XZ precision. The kernel can load packed 4-bit weights, dequantize/scaled them on chip, and combine them with higher-precision activations.
zh: W4A16 等表示法通常意味着权重以 4 位表示形式存储，而激活值保持在 ZXNAME0000XZ/ZXNAME0001XZ 精度左右。内核可以加载打包的 4 位权重，在芯片上对它们进行反量化/缩放，并将它们与更高精度的激活相结合。
